fact: Basidia is a myconid sovereign who guides the party through the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: Basidia, the myconid sovereign who had been guiding the party through the Neverlight Grove
subject: Basidia

fact: Hebopbe is the obsessive leader of the Circle of Growers.
source_quote: They then met Hebopbe, the obsessive leader of the Circle of Growers
subject: Hebopbe

fact: Gyrgum appears visibly confused when Hebopbe explains that myconids are herbivores.
source_quote: a distinction that left Gyrgum visibly confused
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Thorin compares the myconid agricultural arrangement to a mammal eating other mammals.
source_quote: Thorin compared the arrangement to a mammal eating other mammals
subject: Thorin

fact: Phylo is a sovereign responsible for political upheaval in the colony.
source_quote: Hebopbe was indifferent to the political upheaval caused by the sovereign Phylo
subject: Phylo

fact: Yrberop is the leader of the circle mound where new myconids are spored and grown.
source_quote: The mound's leader, Yrberop, was visibly infected
subject: Yrberop

fact: Rumpadump is a nervous and energetic myconid scout who advocates for a nomadic way of life.
source_quote: where they met Rumpadump, a nervous and energetic myconid scout who advocated passionately for a nomadic way of life
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Jimjar is a companion of the party who behaves strangely by placing no bets.
source_quote: Meanwhile, their companion Jimjar had been behaving strangely — hinting at a coming wedding and, most tellingly, placing no bets at all
subject: Jimjar

fact: The Circle of Growers is led by Hebopbe and cultivates specific fungi for food.
source_quote: Hebopbe, the obsessive leader of the Circle of Growers, who proudly explained that myconids were herbivores who cultivated specific fungi for food
subject: Circle of Growers

fact: The Circle of Explorers is led by Rumpadump and consists of scouts, patrols, pathfinders, and visionaries.
source_quote: He described the explorers as the colony's scouts, patrols, pathfinders, and visionaries beyond the boundaries of Neverlight Grove
subject: Circle of Explorers

fact: Myconids are a sentient species with varied tastes, cooking styles, and agricultural practices.
source_quote: explaining that they were a sentient species with their own varied tastes, cooking styles, and agricultural practices
subject: myconids

fact: The Neverlight Grove is the location of the myconid colony the party tours.
source_quote: guiding the party through the Neverlight Grove
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: The Overbright is mentioned as a destination where myconids plan to spread happiness, which the party knows would be fatal or unnatural for them.
source_quote: He spoke excitedly of sending myconids into the Overbright, something the party knew should be fatal or deeply unnatural for them
subject: Overbright

fact: The Garden of Welcome is the final stop of the tour, which the party suspects involves demonic sacrifice.
source_quote: Their final stop before the Garden of Welcome was the Circle of Explorers
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: The circle mound is where new myconids are spored and grown, featuring a forest of awakened zurkhwood trees nearby.
source_quote: Next, the party visited the circle mound where new myconids were spored and grown
subject: circle mound

fact: Hebopbe shows off his prized zurkhwood and other favored cultivated fungi.
source_quote: Hebopbe shows off his prized zurkhwood and other favored cultivated fungi
subject: zurkhwood

fact: Newly spored myconids are only a few inches tall and not yet aware.
source_quote: Basidia showed them newly spored myconids only a few inches tall, not yet aware but soon to mature into myconid sprouts
subject: myconid

fact: The zurkhwood trees in the forest near the circle mound are awakened and sentient.
source_quote: passing through a forest that includes awakened, sentient zurkhwood trees
subject: zurkhwood

fact: Zuggtmoy is a demonic entity praised by Yrberop and Phylo, described in feminine terms and associated with a coming wedding.
source_quote: He spoke excitedly of sending myconids into the Overbright... Yrberop praises the “great Zuggtmoy”
subject: Zuggtmoy

fact: The party suspects the Garden of Welcome visit is intended to make them sacrifices to a demon.
source_quote: The party increasingly suspected that the promised visit to the Garden of Welcome was intended to make them sacrifices to a demon
subject: demon

fact: Basidia reveals that Hebopbe has been infected by strange evil spores.
source_quote: What Basidia quietly revealed, however, was that Hebopbe had already been infected by the strange evil spores spreading through the colony
subject: Hebopbe infected

fact: Hebopbe is infected by strange evil spores.
source_quote: Hebopbe has already been infected by the strange evil spores spreading through the colony
subject: Hebopbe

fact: Yrberop is visibly infected and sways to discordant internal music.
source_quote: The mound's leader, Yrberop, was visibly infected and swayed to discordant internal music that no one else could hear
subject: Yrberop infected

fact: Yrberop is infected and hears a chaotic cacophony through his mind.
source_quote: Yrberop, was visibly infected and swayed to discordant internal music that no one else could hear — a chaotic, painful cacophony
subject: Yrberop

fact: Thorin connects the noise Yrberop hears to his own dark memory of a demonic presence.
source_quote: Thorin, drawing on a dark memory of his own time spent in the presence of something deeply wrong, felt certain that the noise and the evil he had encountered before were connected
subject: Thorin recognizes threat

fact: Yrberop croons a lullaby to the newly spored myconids that praises Zuggtmoy and her wedding.
source_quote: Yrberop lost interest in the conversation and began crooning a lullaby to the newly spored myconids
subject: Yrberop sings lullaby

fact: Phylo previously described Zuggtmoy in reverent, feminine terms and stated she must be experienced firsthand.
source_quote: Phylo had previously described Zuggtmoy in reverent, specifically feminine terms and claimed that she could answer any question, but refused to explain what she was
subject: Phylo quote

fact: Phylo describes Zuggtmoy in feminine terms and claims she can answer any question.
source_quote: Phylo had previously described Zuggtmoy in reverent, specifically feminine terms and claimed that she could answer any question
subject: Phylo

fact: Rumpadump has prepared escape routes and hidden nutrient caches in the exit tunnels.
source_quote: He had already prepared escape routes and hidden nutrient caches in the exit tunnels in case Basidia chose to abandon the grove
subject: Rumpadump escape prep

fact: Nutrient caches are hidden in the exit tunnels for a potential nomadic migration.
source_quote: hidden nutrient caches in the exit tunnels
subject: nutrient caches

fact: Rumpadump offers the party a way into the Garden of Welcome through a secret passageway.
source_quote: It was Rumpadump who offered the party a way into the Garden of Welcome through a secret passageway
subject: Rumpadump secret passageway

fact: Jimjar offers to bet that he was never infected by spores when challenged.
source_quote: When challenged, Jimjar returned briefly to form by offering to bet that he had never been infected by spores
subject: Jimjar bets

fact: Jimjar is not infected by the strange spores.
source_quote: Basidia confirmed that he was not infected
subject: Jimjar

fact: The party accepts Rumpadump's offer to investigate the Garden of Welcome immediately.
source_quote: The party accepts immediately, comparing the decision to turning to the obviously fatal page of a choose-your-own-adventure book
subject: party enters passage

fact: The party compares their decision to enter the secret passageway to turning to the fatal page of a choose-your-own-adventure book.
source_quote: comparing the decision to turning to the obviously fatal page of a choose-your-own-adventure book
subject: choose-your-own-adventure book

fact: Phylo's guided tour is scheduled for the morning.
source_quote: without waiting for Phylo's guided tour in the morning
subject: morning

fact: Yrberop mentions a 'great plan' by a 'great cedar' to bring happiness to all.
source_quote: Yrberop speaks cryptically about a “great plan” by a “great cedar” to bring happiness to all
subject: great plan

fact: The lullaby and Phylo's hints reference a coming wedding between Zuggtmoy and a 'great body'.
source_quote: His lullaby praises Zuggtmoy, her wedding to the “great body,” and the invitation extended to every myconid
subject: Zuggtmoy wedding

fact: Basidia uses rapport spores to link the party telepathically, shielding them from the corrupting spores in Yrberop's mind.
source_quote: Basidia, rather than Yrberop, is responsible for the rapport spores linking the party, so the telepathic contact does not itself expose them to the corrupting spores
subject: rapport spores

fact: Hebopbe stops his detailed explanation of farming yields upon realizing the party is losing interest.
source_quote: He nearly launches into a detailed explanation of farming yields before recognizing the party's fading interest and deferring the lecture
subject: Hebopbe defers lecture

fact: Basidia bluntly prompts the party to ask Hebopbe about Phylo.
source_quote: Basidia bluntly prompts the party to ask Hebopbe about Phylo, demonstrating little talent for discretion
subject: Basidia prompts

fact: Hebopbe points out the terraces and cultivation program supplying the colony.
source_quote: Hebopbe proudly points out the terraces and extensive cultivation program that keeps the colony supplied with varied food
subject: Hebopbe shows food

fact: Newly spored myconids will mature into myconid sprouts.
source_quote: newly spored myconids only a few inches tall, not yet aware but soon to mature into myconid sprouts
subject: myconid sprout

fact: Phylo refuses to explain Zuggtmoy, stating one must experience it firsthand.
source_quote: One cannot be told what the great Zuggtmoy is. One must experience it firsthand.
subject: Zuggtmoy quote

fact: Rumpadump trusts only Basidia and the party because Basidia vouches for them.
source_quote: Rumpadump trusted only Basidia and, by extension, the party, and he made no secret of his fear that something terrible was unfolding in the grove
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Rumpadump observes the colony changes further and for the worse upon each return from an expedition.
source_quote: Every time he returned from an expedition, he found the colony changed further and for the worse
subject: Rumpadump colony change

fact: Jimjar explains his lack of bets by claiming weddings make people unhappy.
source_quote: Jimjar claims that nothing is wrong beyond the general truth that “anytime there's a wedding, you know, people get unhappy.”
subject: Jimjar excuse
